# google_parameter_manager_template_version

A TemplateVersion resource stores the templated payload for a Template, using
`{{.variableName}}` placeholders that are resolved from a ParameterVersion's
data at render time.


To get more information about TemplateVersion, see:

* [API documentation](https://cloud.google.com/secret-manager/parameter-manager/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.locations.templates.versions)

~> **Warning:** All arguments including the following potentially sensitive
values will be stored in the raw state as plain text: `template_data`.
[Read more about sensitive data in state](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/manage-sensitive-data).

## Example Usage - Template Version Basic


```hcl
resource "google_parameter_manager_template" "template-basic" {
  template_id = "template"
}

resource "google_parameter_manager_template_version" "template-version-basic" {
  template             = google_parameter_manager_template.template-basic.id
  template_version_id  = "template_version"
  template_data        = "greeting: hello {{.name}}"
}
```

</div>
## Example Usage - Template Version With Json Format


```hcl
resource "google_parameter_manager_template" "template-basic" {
  template_id = "template"
  format      = "TEMPLATE_FORMAT_JSON"
}

resource "google_parameter_manager_template_version" "template-version-with-json-format" {
  template             = google_parameter_manager_template.template-basic.id
  template_version_id  = "template_version"
  template_data = jsonencode({
    "greeting" : "hello {{.name}}"
  })
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `template_data` -
  (Required)
  The template data. Use `{{.variableName}}` placeholders for values
  that are resolved from a ParameterVersion's data when the
  TemplateVersion is rendered.
  **Note**: This property is sensitive and will not be displayed in the plan.

* `template` -
  (Required)
  Parameter Manager Template resource.

* `template_version_id` -
  (Required)
  Version ID of the Template Version resource. This must be unique within the Template.


* `disabled` -
  (Optional)
  The current state of the TemplateVersion. If true, the payload is
  never returned by read or render calls. This field is only applicable
  for updating a TemplateVersion.

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.


## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `{{template}}/versions/{{template_version_id}}`

* `name` -
  The resource name of the TemplateVersion. Format:
  `projects/{{project}}/locations/global/templates/{{template_id}}/versions/{{template_version_id}}`

* `create_time` -
  The time at which the TemplateVersion was created.

* `update_time` -
  The time at which the TemplateVersion was updated.


## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `update` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 20 minutes.

## Import


TemplateVersion can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/locations/global/templates/{{template_id}}/versions/{{template_version_id}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/import#identity) to import TemplateVersion using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    template_version_id = "<-required value->"
  }
  to = google_parameter_manager_template_version.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import TemplateVersion using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/locations/global/templates/{{template_id}}/versions/{{template_version_id}}"
  to = google_parameter_manager_template_version.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), TemplateVersion can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_parameter_manager_template_version.default projects/{{project}}/locations/global/templates/{{template_id}}/versions/{{template_version_id}}
```
